_comment: A sanitized audit trail for one end-to-end case: an inbound refund request that was
acknowledged by draft, escalated to a human, approved, executed by hand under a
separate credential, and reported back to the operator after commit.
Every identifier, timestamp and hash on this page is synthetic. The column set, the actor
convention and the metadata shapes are those of the real control-plane table:
audit_event(event_id, task_id, run_id, event_type, actor, created_at, metadata).
Provider-specific event names are generalised here - the implementation names its mail
events after the provider it is bound to; the shape is unchanged.
The table is append-only by privilege - the writing role holds INSERT and has no UPDATE
and no DELETE - so a correction is a new row and history is never rewritten.
metadata is a bounded summary: long strings are truncated and secret-shaped keys and
values are redacted before the row is written, so no token, connection string or full
tool response can ever reach this table.

case.story: Refund request for order SO-1004 - see examples/synthetic-approval.md

audit_event._stage: 1. the message is read - a GET, nothing is mutated in the mailbox
2. the attempt is claimed and COMMITTED before any provider write - this row is what crash reconciliation searches for
3. the unit of work exists. The idempotency key is the message identity, so twenty concurrent runs share one task
4. the agent starts. Entity extraction is deterministic and ran before the model - SO-1004 was found by a regex, not by an inference
5. first tool call. Read-only by database grant, not by prompt instruction
6. the result is summarised, never stored whole. output_excerpt is capped and scrubbed
7. second tool call - the customer record, still read-only
8. grounded. Two facts, both traceable to a tool result
9. the deterministic policy layer classified the case. No model chose this risk level and no model chose this disposition
10. an acknowledgement draft was created in the source thread. It promises nothing, because no outcome exists yet
11. a duplicate delivery of the same message. The task is reused and NO second draft is created
12. a human decided. actor names the person and the channel. There is zero model involvement in this path

metadata.reason: Damage confirmed from photos in the thread.

audit_event._stage: 13. a second decision was attempted and refused. The refusal is a row, not a silent no-op
14. NOTE THE GAP: 4 minutes and 27 seconds after the decision, still nothing refunded. No queue consumed the approval. A human ran a second program under a different database login
15. preconditions re-validated inside the writing transaction: approved, unexpired, hash still matching, entity still refundable, no prior success
16. the single business write. before and after digests make the effect auditable without storing the row itself
17. the operator is told, AFTER commit. The notification reports a fact and can start nothing

_what_this_trail_proves: The read at 10:40:51 mutated nothing: labels and unread state were identical afterwards.
Between event 9 and event 16 the case sat for 26 minutes with an authorization on file and zero business rows written. Approval is not execution.
Event 11 is a duplicate delivery that produced no second draft.
Event 13 is a second decision attempt that was refused by a unique constraint.
Event 14 names a human as invoked_by. No scheduler and no queue appears anywhere in this file.
Exactly one write_execution_succeeded exists for this approval, and exactly one business row changed.
The notification at event 17 is emitted after the commit at event 16, never before.
Nothing in metadata is a token, a credential, a connection string or a full message body.

_event_types_not_shown_here._note: Terminal and refusal paths that this happy-ish case did not take. Each is a row, never a silent failure.
_event_types_not_shown_here.security_rejected: an injection attempt was detected and recorded
_event_types_not_shown_here.grounding_violation: the model asserted a fact no tool returned - the run fails and no draft is created
_event_types_not_shown_here.ambiguity_gated: no usable identifier - a clarification is drafted instead of a guess
_event_types_not_shown_here.approval_expired: the decision window closed before a human decided
_event_types_not_shown_here.approval_snapshot_mismatch: the entity changed between authorization and decision - the approval is cancelled, not honoured
_event_types_not_shown_here.write_execution_blocked: a precondition failed inside the transaction - nothing was written
_event_types_not_shown_here.write_execution_failed: the attempt errored and rolled back - nothing was written
_event_types_not_shown_here.write_execution_reconciled: a crash in the mutation window was resolved without writing twice
_event_types_not_shown_here.mail_processing_failed: the run ended with no draft
_event_types_not_shown_here.execution_notification_failed: the operator channel was unreachable; the notification is retried, the execution is untouched
